{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Celebration of Life''' was an event on [[Kirdo III/Legends|Kirdo III]] that occurred every [[Standard decade/Legends|standard decade]]. During this time, the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Kurdan Desert]] experienced rainfall, prompting all [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonaks]] to migrate to the desert to engage in the celebration to participate in their mating ritual, the [[Dance of Love]]. Females of the species were fertilized with young during the ritual, which began a ten [[Standard year/Legends|year]] gestation period; Kitonak females would then give birth during the next Great Celebration.
